name: Strait of Hormuz
status_note: Effectively closed to routine commercial shipping since 28 Feb 2026; a brief mid-June reopening broke down in early July.

name: Red Sea / Bab-el-Mandeb
status_note: Operating at reduced capacity due to recurring attacks on shipping; disrupted further as the Hormuz crisis deepened.

name: Cape of Good Hope reroute
status_note: Longer alternative route used by tankers avoiding Red Sea/Hormuz risk; adds 10-14 transit days.

name: Suez Canal
status_note: Traffic tied to Red Sea approach risk; volumes fluctuate with attack activity.
